_readme: Examples of the two optional per-project config files in .flutter-store-deploy/ at the project root.
Copy each top-level object below into its own file: .flutter-store-deploy/ios.json and .flutter-store-deploy/android.json.
ios.json holds verbatim ExportOptions.plist keys, deep-merged over templates/ExportOptions.default.plist (project value wins).
For automatic signing, ios.json can be as small as: {"signingStyle": "automatic"}.
android.json: serviceAccountKeyPath enables Phase 1 (Play Developer API); when absent, Phase 2 (Claude in Chrome) is used with the hints below.
This config is safe to commit — the service-account key itself must live OUTSIDE the repo.
